title: LuckRead Block and Mute API Contract
purpose: Production contract for user block and mute relationships. This contract is subordinate to the canonical OpenAPI document and interaction-operation-policy.v1.json.
invariants: actorId MUST be derived from the authenticated server-side principal and MUST NOT be accepted from the request body.
targetUserId MUST be resolved server-side and MUST refer to an existing user in the caller's authorization scope.
self-block and self-mute MUST be rejected unless a future explicit product policy permits them.
Repeated block or mute requests MUST be idempotent and MUST NOT create duplicate authoritative relationship rows.
Unblock and unmute MUST be idempotent when the relationship is already absent.
Block takes precedence over follow, like, comment, message, feed, search and notification visibility where the target relationship is applicable.
Mute MUST NOT imply block; it suppresses applicable distribution or notification surfaces without deleting the underlying relationship or content.
A block or unblock mutation MUST invalidate or version-bump affected private relationship, feed, search and notification caches before stale authorization-sensitive results can be reused.
The mutation MUST emit a bounded asynchronous domain event after the authoritative write; synchronous downstream fan-out is forbidden.
The operation MUST enforce account-state, relationship-state, anti-abuse and tenant/scope checks before the authoritative write.
Client-supplied counters, moderation state, account state, actor identity and relationship state MUST never be trusted.
Concurrent duplicate mutations MUST converge to one authoritative relationship state through an atomic uniqueness/state constraint or equivalent transaction-safe mechanism.

audit.record: relationship mutation and security-sensitive actor/target identifiers

propagation.principle: Propagation is enforced server-side by domain policy; clients MUST NOT be trusted to filter blocked or muted users.
